segments.source: The ICC version 2.x profile format differs from the version 1.0 profile format, and ColorSync Manager routines for updating a profile and searching for profiles do not work with version 1.0 profiles.
segments.normalizedSource: The ICC version 2.x profile format differs from the version 1.0 profile format, and ColorSync Manager routines for updating a profile and searching for profiles do not work with version 1.0 profiles.

segments.contextAfter: However, your application can use version 1.0 profiles with all other ColorSync routines.

segments.source: However, your application can use version 1.0 profiles with all other ColorSync routines.
segments.normalizedSource: However, your application can use version 1.0 profiles with all other ColorSync routines.
segments.contextBefore: The ICC version 2.x profile format differs from the version 1.0 profile format, and ColorSync Manager routines for updating a profile and searching for profiles do not work with version 1.0 profiles.
segments.contextAfter: For example, you can open a version 1.0 profile using the function [`CMOpenProfile`](colorsync_manager/1804853-cmopenprofile.md), obtain the version 1.0 profile header using the function [`CMGetProfileHeader`](colorsync_manager/1804879-cmgetprofileheader.md), and access version 1.0 profile elements using the function [`CMGetProfileElement`](colorsync_manager/1804973-cmgetprofileelement.md).
segments.documentTitle: Element Tags and Signatures for Version 1.0 Profiles

segments.source: For example, you can open a version 1.0 profile using the function [`CMOpenProfile`](colorsync_manager/1804853-cmopenprofile.md), obtain the version 1.0 profile header using the function [`CMGetProfileHeader`](colorsync_manager/1804879-cmgetprofileheader.md), and access version 1.0 profile elements using the function [`CMGetProfileElement`](colorsync_manager/1804973-cmgetprofileelement.md).
segments.normalizedSource: For example, you can open a version 1.0 profile using the function [`CMOpenProfile`](colorsync_manager/1804853-cmopenprofile.md), obtain the version 1.0 profile header using the function [`CMGetProfileHeader`](colorsync_manager/1804879-cmgetprofileheader.md), and access version 1.0 profile elements using the function [`CMGetProfileElement`](colorsync_manager/1804973-cmgetprofileelement.md).
segments.contextBefore: However, your application can use version 1.0 profiles with all other ColorSync routines.
segments.contextAfter: To make this possible, the ColorSync Manager includes support for the version 1.0 profile header structure and synthesizes tags to allow you to access four 1.0 elements outside the version 1.0 profile header.
segments.documentTitle: Element Tags and Signatures for Version 1.0 Profiles
